uncited: FlashGS extends the tile-based rasterization with radix sort pipeline by distributing tile processing across multiple GPUs [Tile-based Rasterization with Radix Sort](7921-tile-based-rasterization-with-radix-sort.md).

**Local Rasterization:** Each GPU processes its assigned tiles using the standard tile-based rasterization pipeline [Tile-based Rasterization with Radix Sort](7921-tile-based-rasterization-with-radix-sort.md).

This involves projecting Gaussians, assigning them to tiles, packing 64-bit sort keys (tile ID in high bits, depth in low bits), performing a global radix sort, and executing front-to-back compositing per tile [Tile-based Rasterization with Radix Sort](7921-tile-based-rasterization-with-radix-sort.md).

**Gradient Computation:** The same sorted lists are reused for backpropagation to compute gradients for position, shape, opacity, and color without additional sorting [Tile-based Rasterization with Radix Sort](7921-tile-based-rasterization-with-radix-sort.md).
